layers.name: design tokens
layers.fix: Tokens know nothing about what uses them. Pass the value in from the app.

layers.name: core
layers.fix: Both apps import core, so core imports neither. Move the shared code into packages/core.

layers.name: site
layers.fix: The site deploys without the product. Move the shared code into packages/core or packages/design.

layers.name: browser journeys
layers.fix: A journey drives Holler as a person does. Read the page or call /api/dev instead of importing product code.

layers.name: client lib
layers.fix: lib holds no components. Move the component part into components, or the plain part into lib.

layers.name: client primitives
layers.fix: A primitive knows no Holler component. Take it as children or a prop, or move it into components/ui.

layers.name: client components
layers.fix: Components are drawn by routes and by the design site, so they import neither. Move the shared part into components or lib.

layers.name: design site
layers.fix: The design site shows components, not pages. Move what it shows into components.

layers.name: client routes
layers.fix: The product never imports the server or the design site. Share a type through packages/core; read data through the API.

layers.name: services
layers.fix: Routes, Slack handlers and MCP tools call services, never the other way. Move the shared code into services.

layers.name: blocks
layers.fix: A block builder is a pure function of what it is given. Have the service load the data and pass it in.

layers.name: slack api
layers.fix: The Slack client is what services call. Pass the value in from the service.

layers.name: slack handlers
layers.fix: Every door calls a service. Move what two doors share into services.

layers.name: routes
layers.fix: Every door calls a service. Move what two doors share into services.

layers.name: mcp
layers.fix: Every door calls a service. Move what two doors share into services.

layers.name: foundation
layers.fix: The database, the environment and the signing helpers know nothing about hollers. Move the code into services.

layers.name: test support
layers.fix: Test support is for tests only. Move what the product needs into services.

layers.name: server
layers.fix: The Worker never imports the client or test support. Share a type through packages/core.
